title: flintridge target site occupancy recommendation
instruction:
You are Dagny Dunbar, the tenant-representation agent advising Hollowpine Field Services. Hollowpine's lease on the building used by its laboratory group ends in fourteen months, and Efua Sundqvist, the facilities director, has asked for a recommendation that the facilities committee can vote on in November. The committee has three candidate shells and a difficult occupancy problem: the lowest-cost option has the floor loading the instrument bay needs but requires an exhaust retrofit that may consume the phased-move window; the turnkey option is ready sooner but cannot demonstrate compliance with the instrument bay's vibration requirement; and the third option's landlord will not commit to separating badging for the laboratory and general occupants. The isotope suite is only one room among the laboratory rooms, but its controls and occupancy implications cannot simply be treated as part of the general fit-out. Callum Yamamoto will provide the biosafety sign-off, so keep the boundary between your tenant-representation recommendation and his technical or regulatory authority explicit. Use the complete comparison and requirements bundle in `candidate_site_evidence.xlsx` as the sole factual source. Prepare `target_site_occupancy_recommendation.pptx` in the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename. It is for Efua, the facilities committee, and legal counsel, so make one clear recommendation for a building and occupancy configuration, show the assumptions and projected timing and cost tradeoffs behind it, explain why each other candidate was set aside, and identify the conditions that must be confirmed before contracting or occupancy. Keep the deck to no more than eight slides, make it readable when circulated without an oral presentation, distinguish sourced facts from estimates, and do not invent prices, approvals, test results, or biosafety conclusions. The recommendation must address the phased move, the instrument bay, the isotope suite, access separation, and the fourteen-month lease deadline without turning this into a system procedure or a substitute for Callum's sign-off.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/candidate_site_evidence.xlsx` — Complete factual evidence bundle for the three candidate buildings, laboratory requirements, lease timing, cost and schedule assumptions, occupancy constraints, and responsibility boundaries used in the recommendation.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `target_site_occupancy_recommendation.pptx` — A target-site and occupancy-configuration recommendation deck for the facilities committee and legal counsel. (Exactly this filename at the top level of the working directory; no more than eight slides; readable without an oral presentation; one clear recommendation; distinguish sourced facts, assumptions, estimates, and unresolved confirmations; do not add unsupported prices, approvals, test results, or biosafety conclusions.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

spec.professional_context: A tenant-representation agent must convert a mixed evidence bundle into a defensible site and occupancy recommendation before a facilities committee vote, while preserving the boundary between commercial advice and biosafety authority.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling cost, schedule, technical suitability, and access-control tradeoffs across three candidates
Modeling a phased move under a fourteen-month lease deadline with a constrained fallback
Separating general fit-out assumptions from the isotope-suite and instrument-bay gates
Writing a decision-ready recommendation while preserving the tenant-representation and biosafety authority boundary

source_file.purpose: Build one complete, internally consistent evidence workbook covering three synthetic candidate buildings, laboratory requirements, lease timing, cost assumptions, move phases, access constraints, and responsibility boundaries. Use stable candidate labels and do not rely on external facts.
content_constraints: Include exactly three candidate shells with distinct tradeoffs matching the brief: one lowest-cost site with adequate instrument-bay floor loading but an exhaust retrofit whose duration materially threatens the phased-move window; one turnkey site with earlier readiness but a documented inability to demonstrate the instrument-bay vibration requirement; and one site whose landlord refuses a contractual commitment to separated badging.
Include the fourteen-month lease horizon and explicit durations or dates sufficient to test whether each candidate can be ready in time.
Include cost components sufficient to reconcile total projected occupancy cost for each candidate, with at least one estimate clearly labeled as an estimate.
Include general laboratory requirements and a separate isotope-suite requirement set; the isotope suite must be one room among the laboratory rooms and must require distinct confirmation.
Include access populations or zones sufficient to test separated badging and controlled laboratory occupancy.

Include a short responsibility statement making the tenant-representation agent responsible for commercial recommendation and Callum Yamamoto or a biosafety authority responsible for biosafety/isotope-suite sign-off.
Include a resource or time constraint that makes an ideal sequential retrofit-and-move plan infeasible for at least one candidate, while leaving a defensible fallback or mitigation available.
Include no hidden defects, contradictory facts, or external lookups.

gold_derivation.method: Derive the reference recommendation by reconciling the source requirements, calculating like-for-like projected cost and schedule, testing each candidate's technical and access gates, and selecting the candidate with the strongest defensible fit within the lease window. The exact winning candidate and figures should be determined from the constructed workbook rather than prescribed in the rubric.
gold_requirements: The gold deck must make exactly one recommendation and explain why both rejected candidates fail or carry less acceptable risk.
It must model cost and timing, distinguish facts from assumptions, and keep all displayed calculations consistent.
It must describe a phased occupancy configuration, separately handle the isotope suite and instrument bay, and include a bounded fallback for the constrained schedule.
It must assign pre-contract and pre-occupancy confirmations to concrete owners and preserve the agent-versus-biosafety boundary.
It must discourage the common misuse of treating general fit-out, turnkey readiness, or informal landlord assurances as proof of special-room, vibration, or access compliance.

authoring_plan.artifact_guidance: The build agent should create a realistic compact evidence workbook and a polished presentation with its own sensible slide structure. Do not encode the answer in the request, rubric literal cell references, or arbitrary local codes. Use source labels and traceable notes so a solver can prepare the deck offline.

reference_files.purpose: Complete factual evidence bundle for the three candidate buildings, laboratory requirements, lease timing, cost and schedule assumptions, occupancy constraints, and responsibility boundaries used in the recommendation.
reference_files.discovery: Open this workbook before preparing the recommendation; it is the sole supplied factual source.

deliverables.description: A target-site and occupancy-configuration recommendation deck for the facilities committee and legal counsel.
constraints: Exactly this filename at the top level of the working directory; no more than eight slides; readable without an oral presentation; one clear recommendation; distinguish sourced facts, assumptions, estimates, and unresolved confirmations; do not add unsupported prices, approvals, test results, or biosafety conclusions.
